## Summary

The corpus contains **13 papers that describe publicly released TCIA (The Cancer Imaging Archive) imaging datasets**:

### Head & Neck Cancer
- [PMID:24892406](papers/24892406.html) — Aerts et al. 2014 (*Nature Communications*): Used TCIA [NSCLC-Radiomics Lung1](datasets/tcia-nsclc-radiomics-lung1.html) (n=422) as training cohort and validated across two TCIA HNSCC cohorts: [H&N1 MAASTRO](datasets/tcia-hn1-maastro.html) (n=136) and [H&N2 VU Amsterdam](datasets/tcia-hn2-vumc.html) (n=95).
- [PMID:30179230](papers/30179230.html) — Grossberg et al. 2018 (*Scientific Data*): Descriptor paper for the [TCIA HNSCC (MD Anderson)](datasets/tcia-hnscc.html) collection (n=215) with multi-timepoint PET-CT, RT planning DICOMs, and body composition annotations.
- [PMID:37397861](papers/37397861.html) — Kim et al. 2023 (*Radiotherapy and Oncology*): Used [RADCURE](datasets/radcure.html) (n=3346), [TCIA H&N1](datasets/tcia-hn1-maastro.html), [H&N2](datasets/tcia-hn2-vumc.html), and [MD Anderson HNSCC](datasets/tcia-hnscc.html) in multi-institutional prognostic-modeling challenge.

### Lung Cancer & Radiomics Stability  
- [PMID:24892406](papers/24892406.html) — Aerts et al. 2014: Derived and validated radiomic prognostic signature using [NSCLC-Radiomics Lung1](datasets/tcia-nsclc-radiomics-lung1.html), plus TCIA [RIDER Lung CT](datasets/tcia-rider-lung.html) test-retest cohort (n=31) and [Multiple Delineation](datasets/tcia-multiple-delineation.html) inter-observer cohort (n=21×5 delineations).

### Glioma MRI Imaging  
- [PMID:28872634](papers/28872634.html) — Bakas et al. 2017 (*Scientific Data*): Released TCIA [TCGA-GBM MRI](datasets/tcia-tcga-gbm.html) (n=135) and [TCGA-LGG MRI](datasets/tcia-tcga-lgg.html) (n=108) collections with expert-revised tumor segmentation labels and radiomic features. Became BraTS'17 reference standard.

### Ovarian Cancer  
- [PMID:35764743](papers/35764743.html) — Boehm et al. 2022 (*Nature Cancer*): Used [TCIA TCGA-OV](datasets/tcia-tcga-ov.html) imaging (n=148 with CT) paired with genomic data for multimodal HGSOC prognostic modeling.

### Radiation Therapy Planning  
- [PMID:38362943](papers/38362943.html) — Welch et al. 2024 (*Medical Physics*): Descriptor paper for [RADCURE](datasets/radcure.html), the largest TCIA HNSCC dataset (n=3,346) with standardised RT-STRUCT contours and longitudinal outcomes.

All of these datasets are **publicly available on TCIA** (https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/) and linked to peer-reviewed publications describing their composition, use cases, and clinical/radiomics applications.

rag.answer:
Based on the passages provided, the following papers describe publicly released TCIA imaging datasets:

1. **PMID:28872634** - Describes segmentation labels and radiomic features for glioma datasets from TCGA/TCIA, including 243 pre-operative multimodal MRI scans from glioblastoma (n=135) and low-grade glioma (n=108) collections (PMID:28872634).

2. **PMID:30325352** - Presents a radiogenomic dataset from a Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) cohort of 211 subjects with CT, PET/CT images, semantic annotations, and tumor segmentation maps publicly accessible via TCIA (PMID:30325352).

3. **PMID:30179230** - Describes the HNSCC (Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma) collection, a single-institutional dataset of 215 patients with diagnostic imaging, radiotherapy structure, planning, and dose data made publicly available through TCIA (PMID:30179230).

4. **PMID:38362943** - References RADCURE, a comprehensive dataset with imaging, clinical, demographic, and treatment data for head and neck cancer that is publicly accessible via TCIA (PMID:38362943).
